AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MEETING
  Council Chambers, City Hall – 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the meeting of the Civil Service Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the
week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by
  calling (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Council Chambers.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
  for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services.

All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will
  be available for review in the Human Resources office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 100, Glendale, CA 91206.

  If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact Human Resources at (818) 548-2110 during
  regular business hours.

  June 12, 2019 at 5:00 p.m.
  1.  ROLL CALL

  2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of May 8, 2019.

  3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes.
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  No action required.

  5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  No action required.

  6.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – VERDUGO FIRE MANAGER (MARTIN)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Verdugo Fire Manager as submitted.

  7.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL – COMMUNITY SERVICES SPECIALIST / COMMUNITY CENTERS
  (NAVARRO)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Community Services Specialist / Community Centers as
  submitted.

  8.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL – FIRE BATTALION CHIEF (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Fire Battalion Chief as submitted.

  9.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL – PRINCIPAL LIBRARY, ARTS & CULTURE ADMINISTRATOR /
  TECHNOLOGY, INNOVATION AND COLLECTIONS (PETROSYAN)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Principal Library, Arts & Culture Administrator / Technology,
  Innovation and Collections as submitted.

  10. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION – REPORT ON UNCLASSIFIED STATUS PROPOSAL FOR COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT / HOUSING SECTION POSITIONS (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Adoption of Resolution.
   11. REPORTS – INFORMATION (Page 38)
  a) Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  12. CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS

  13. CLOSED SESSION
  a) Public Employee Discipline: Police Officer

  14. ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

As required by law, this agenda for the Civil Service Commission Meeting of June 12, 2019 was posted at or
before 4:00 p.m. on May 7, 2019 on the City Hall Bulletin Board.

..  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  June 12, 2019
  City Council Chambers

l.  ROLL CALL
  Chair MacCarley called the meeting to order at 5:04 pm.

  Present: Manoukian 1 Ghazarian, Chair MacCarley.
  Absent: Devine, Abkarian.

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of May 8, 2019.

  This item was differed to the next Civil Service Commission meeting.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  Walter Alvarez addressed the Commission.

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Eligible Lists Established.

6.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL-VERDUGO FIRE MANAGER (MARTIN)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Verdugo Fire Manager as submitted.

  The class specification for Verdugo Fire Manager was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Devine, Abkarian

7.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL- COMMUNITY SERVICES SPECIALIST/ COMMUNITY CENTERS {NAVARRO)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Community Services Specialist/ Community Centers as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Community Services Specialist/ Community Centers was approved as submitted by the
  following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Devine, Abkarian

8.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL- FIRE BATTALION CHIEF {CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Fire Battalion Chief as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Fire Battalion Chief was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Devine, Abkarian
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of June 12, 2019
  Page 2 of 3

9.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL-PRINCIPAL LIBRARY, ARTS & CULTURE ADMINISTRATOR /TECHNOLOGY,
  INNOVATION AND COLLECTIONS (PETROSYAN)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Principal Library, Arts & Culture Administrator/ Technology, Innovation
  and Collections as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Principal Library, Arts & Culture Administrator/ Technology, Innovation and Collections
  was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Devine, Abkarian

10.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION - REPORT ON UNCLASSIFIED STATUS PROPOSAL FOR COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT/ HOUSING SECTION POSITIONS (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Adoption of Resolution.
  The Resolution for unclassified status proposal for Community Development Department/ Housing Section
  Positions was adopted as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Devine, Abkarian

11.  REPORTS - INFORMATION
  a)  Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations Report.

12.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  Commissioner Ghazarian expressed his gratitude for the many years of service that former Council member
  Zareh Sinanyan contributed to the City of Glendale and noted that Mr. Sinanyan has accepted a government
  position in the Republic of Armenia. Chair MacCarley and Commissioner Manoukian concurred with
  Commissioner Ghazarian's sentiment. Mr. Doyle thanked the members of the Civil Service Commission and
  the employee associations for all the hard work they put into the Civil Service Rules and Regulations
  amendment process and provided the Commissioners with newly updated Civil Service Rules and
  Regulations.

13.  CLOSED SESSION
  a)  Public Employee Discipline: Police Officer

  The Commission concluded their deliberation and reported out the following decision:
  On a vote of 3-0, with two Commissioners absent, the Commission upheld the City's disciplinary action.

14.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 5:53 pm.
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of June 12, 2019
